newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 2.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan stuntman Ke Shou-liang succeeds in flying across China's Yellow River with a specially modified sports car.
Nationalist Party, Democratic Progressive Party hold first round of talks on constitutional revision issues.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to allow creditors to access information concerning debtors' assets.
Nationalist Party, Democratic Progressive Party support completion of constitutional amendments at scheduled time.
LIBERTY TIMES - Five French Mirage 2000-5 fighter jets officially handed over to Taiwan's air force.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Teco Electrics decides to buy Chung Hsing Electrics' shares.
Jobless rate among young people remains high.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to lower its "Big Three" commercial banks shares holding to 30 percent.
Foreign fund net outflows increase in May
